Auto-grading -> FSRS rating map using latency relative to the learner's rolling median per exercise type; Easy never auto-assigned; 'I already know this' only on new items
Judge mechanic: 25% of self-rated Good answers get a 2-option verification against a confusable; failing forces Again and feeds a visible 'Honesty %' calibration stat
Error tags (particle, conjugation, vowel-length, voicing, kanji-reading, register, pitch, aizuchi...) with EWMA per tag; any tag >20% spawns a 3-minute targeted set until it drops below 8%

Plateau Arc as mandatory curriculum (4kyu-2kyu): Native Bridge passages (coverage target drops 97%->93%, listening 1.1-1.25x), Breadth Campaign (12-15 new/day from 3k-8k band, J-J definitions), Say It Three Ways (casual/polite/keigo), Monologue Marathon, Reduce & Expand 60/45/30s (Nation 4/3/2)

'What we deliberately cut and why' table as a binding design charter (no hearts, no loot, no leaderboards, no romaji past input, no self-rating as sole grading)

rationale:
The brief asks for four things at once: effective fluency training, positive addictiveness, badges/scores/wallpapers steeped in gaming/martial-arts/anime nostalgia, and innovation, all deliverable as a static Vite/Preact site fed by parallel AI writers. TSUZUKU (gamedesign) is the only proposal that is strong on all four. Its game layer is not decoration: every mechanic (training-dummy combo rule, Guard, Block, item belts from FSRS stability, Zen mode, Gatekeeper bosses sampled toward low retrievability, Kage ghost sets on known material, the load governor that hides the scary backlog) is explicitly tuned so the XP-optimal path is the learning-optimal path, and it documents that in a mechanic-to-learning audit. It also has a real phased build plan with a Stations 0-10 MVP, Zod-validated content, self-contained writer packets (sentences inline in VocabItem, Station aggregate, idRange per file, allowlists), and honest Projected Arrival dates. Total 36 vs 31-32 for the others.

The Kotodama pedagogy proposal is the best pure SLA design (10/10) and the curriculum proposal is the best content-engineering design (9/10 feasibility), but each is weaker on the user's explicit 'addictive' requirement; the nostalgia proposal has the strongest visual and sound identity but the thinnest pedagogy and no content pipeline or phasing.

Recommended build: ship TSUZUKU's loop, bosses, road, stamps, Kage, Omikuji, quests and streak suite, but (1) replace its single-card facet bitmask with the pedagogy proposal's per-facet FSRS cards with staggered unlock, and add its error tags -> Weak Points, aizuchi slots, Judge mechanic, Input Ledger and Plateau Arc countermeasures; (2) adopt the curriculum proposal's content pipeline wholesale: Phase A canonical lists pre-assigning items to stations, station number as writer namespace in IDs, Zod schemas shared by validator and loader, enumerated V-rules with kuromoji i+1 checks, packet generator and repair loop, manifest redirects and release trains; (3) take the nostalgia proposal's typography/color tokens, chiptune recipes, rank ceremony, Mon crest spec and Gojuon Fighter as the visual and audio skin. Biggest risks to manage: Phase 1 mechanic scope (cut Omikuji, fragments, yojijukugo and Kage to Phase 2), unspecified tokenization for coverage validation, and story-bible coherence across parallel writers.
